_help: Supply rows are built automatically from sources.json (one row per country and commodity). Add a volume or note for a supply row under supplyDetails, keyed "<slug>|<Country>", e.g. "coffee|Kenya": {"volume": "40 t per month"}. Demand rows are listed below; delete the sample ones and add yours. Fields: commodity (slug), volume, when, port, country (destination country, spelled as on the map, e.g. Netherlands). Set "sample": true on example rows. Then run: python3 -I build.py
